home.subtitle: A worldbuilding environment for creating interactive maps, notes, connections, and the history of your world
home.libraryCount: World triptych · {{count}} projects in your library

empty.title: Your world awaits its creator
empty.description: Create your first project to begin an exciting journey of building your universe.

deleteConfirm.title: Delete project
deleteConfirm.message: Are you sure you want to delete "{{name}}"? This action cannot be undone.

snackbar.importInvalidFormat: Invalid file format. Campaigner export expected.
snackbar.coverUploadFailed: Project created, but its cover could not be uploaded

createDialog.title: Create new project
createDialog.tipText: A good name sets the tone for your entire world. Think about the genre, atmosphere, and main idea of your story.

cover.title: Cover
cover.optional: Shown in the world library · optional
cover.pick: Drop an image or choose a file
cover.hint: JPG, PNG, or WebP · portrait images work best

navigation.title: How should navigation appear?
navigation.description: This only changes the shell — sections, entries, and content stay the same.
navigation.sidebarDescription: All sections stay visible and entry trees expand in place.
navigation.islandDescription: The canvas fills the screen and navigation appears on demand.
navigation.fixedHint: The floating island will arrive in a future update

palette.title: Color theme
palette.description: Fourteen palettes for the dark interface. Accent and surface colors change.

createDialog.storageHint: The project will be saved in your local Campaigner library

empty.description: Project is empty. Start with what's already in your head — characters, places, or world rules. Connections will appear on their own.

start.title: Where to start
start.hint: Three entries into the world. Order doesn't matter — start with what is clearest.
start.characterDescription: The one through whose eyes the reader sees the world.
start.placeDescription: A state, city, or land where it all begins.
start.dogmaDescription: A rule that cannot be broken in this world.

recent.title: Recently changed
recent.empty: No changes yet. As soon as you create the first entry, it will appear here.

branch.title: Current branch
branch.canonicalHint: You are working in the world's main line. Later you can take a copy and see what would happen if history went another way.
branch.altHint: You are viewing an alternate version of the world.

focus.title: Keeping focus
focus.body: You don't have to start with a world map. Sometimes describing a guard's cloak is enough — and the world already exists.
